name: The Testimony of Trixie Glimmer Smith
source:
After finding the cursed play 'The King in Yellow', Trixie Glimmer Smith, a slacking student at Bluebell University recounts the terrible events that set her a week behind in her coursework.

[From [url=https://digital-poppy.itch.io/trixie]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在发现被诅咒的戏剧《黄衣之王》后，蓝铃大学里一名偷懒的学生特里克茜·格里默·史密斯回忆起一连串可怕事件，而这些事件让她的课程进度落后了一周。

[来源：[url=https://digital-poppy.itch.io/trixie]itch.io[/url]]
